subject: VPC Airlock: architecture & air-lock deployment questionnaire initiation
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@airlockhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Feb 2029 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: VPC Airlock: architecture & air-lock deployment questionnaire initiation

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our call: 

• Goal: qualify Airlock Health for a private/VPC-hosted Redwood deployment with optional air-lock (air‑gapped) read-only inference lanes for regulated workloads.
• Key constraints you mentioned: 
  - PHI touching models for claims automation (HIPAA scope),
  - Existing GCP-hosted EHR data stores in us-west1,
  - Desire for strict egress controls and a minimal external dependency footprint.
• Requested artifacts from us: sample VPC diagram, vendor questionnaire to capture data residency, encryption, and access controls.

Immediate next steps (proposed):
1) We’ll send our VPC / air‑lock questionnaire for your security team to complete (attachment: redwood-vpc-airlock-questionnaire.docx).
2) Please share a network inventory or simplified diagram showing subnets and data flows. If you prefer, we can start from the attached postcall-sketch.png and iterate.
3) Ben and I will prepare a HIPAA/BSA summary and sample BAA language if you indicate PHI scope.
4) Schedule follow-up: propose 30-minute technical deep-dive next week to walk through questionnaire responses.

Attachments: postcall-sketch.png (hand-drawn sketch of proposed VPC segmentation), redwood-vpc-airlock-questionnaire.docx (template)

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0182 | tessa.morgan@redwood.com

From: Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@airlockhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Airlock Health - Security Team <sec@airlockhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Feb 2029 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VPC Airlock: architecture & air-lock deployment questionnaire initiation

Tessa —

Appreciate the follow-up and the sketch. A few clarifications from our side before we dive into the questionnaire:

• SOC 2 status: we are currently remediating two control gaps and expect SOC 2 Type II certification in May 2029.
• HIPAA/PHI: we process PHI in a bounded set of workloads and will require a BAA; legal prefers to review sample BAA language up front.
• Data residency: production PHI and EHR extracts live in GCP us-west1; staging scrubbed datasets are in us-central1.

We can fill the questionnaire but would like to do so behind an NDA before sending detailed network inventory (inventory file attached: current-inventory.csv).

Two asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood provide an example network diagram showing the proposed air‑lock staging zone and egress choke points? (a simple PNG is fine).
2) Do you have a short checklist of minimum firewall / routing controls you expect to see in the customer's VPC to qualify for an air‑locked deployment?

I’ll hold on the inventory until the NDA is in place. Happy to schedule the 30m technical session — Friday or next Monday morning looks good.

Best,
Michael O'Neill
Head of IT & Security | Airlock Health
m.oneill@airlockhealth.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@airlockhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Feb 2029 14:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VPC Airlock: architecture & air-lock deployment questionnaire initiation

Thanks, Michael — that's helpful context. Quick replies and updated artifacts attached.

• SOC 2 / HIPAA: attaching a one-page "BAA & compliance summary" and a sample BAA clause for your legal team to review. If SOC 2 completes in May that aligns well with our typical timeline for a Private rollout.
• Diagram & checklist: attaching a lightweight PNG example (redwood-vpc-airlock-example.png) and a two-page minimum-controls checklist (redwood-minimum-firewall-checklist.pdf). These are generic templates we use for initial qualification.
• Questionnaire: please complete the redwood-vpc-airlock-questionnaire.docx and return when ready. We can redact any fields if you prefer to share partial info first.

NDA: We can push a simple mutual NDA via DocuSign — would you like Ben to initiate that?

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben to open a DocuSign NDA (if you confirm yes).
2) Michael to either 1) send redacted inventory now, or 2) send full inventory after NDA.
3) Schedule the 30m deep-dive: Jordan is available Friday 09:00-11:00 PST or Monday 09:00-10:30 PST. Please confirm a slot.

Attachments: redwood-vpc-airlock-questionnaire.docx, redwood-vpc-airlock-example.png, redwood-minimum-firewall-checklist.pdf, redwood-baa-sample.docx

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@airlockhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Airlock Health - Security Team <sec@airlockhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Feb 2029 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VPC Airlock: architecture & air-lock deployment questionnaire initiation

Tessa —

Thanks for the templates and the checklist. Please go ahead and have Ben send the mutual NDA via DocuSign; once executed we'll provide the detailed inventory and a preliminary network diagram.

Friday at 09:30 PST works for the deep-dive — please send calendar invite to confirm.
